title: Three Weeks and One Short Swab
subtitle: 医学药研 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 医学药研（人与社会·科学与技术·医学与健康科学）
meta: 主题语境：医学药研（人与社会·科学与技术·医学与健康科学）　|　核心词汇：infection　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 infection 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the physician ① treated the infection that no sister in the ward would have recorded, and he said the treating was the whole of the Monday. The ② infection, meaning the wound itself and not the swab, ran three Mondays and stayed unrecorded in the book; a infection, he said, is the only thing in a ward that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ infection in that ward had the same short swab beside it, and the ④ infection at the far tray, meaning the sample they kept for the children to test and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A infection, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the physician said the recording is the part that fills three Mondays.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the infection was the whole of the matter, meaning the risk and not the wound. The ⑥ infection, meaning the risk and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; infection, he said, is either something you treat or the only word that means both a wound and a risk. He said the risk is the part they remember.

By 1981 the ⑦ infection had become a line in a chart, and the chart had become an argument about the short swab. The ⑧ infection of the whole thing, the physician wrote in March, was one ward and three Mondays of recording; infection, he said, is either the sample at the far tray or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ infection I remember is the wound recorded in the chart, which closed in 1983 and is still recorded as the quietest in the ward. A ⑩ infection, my mother said in 1985, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; every infection, she said, is a risk that has agreed to look like a wound. She said the risk was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 感染；发炎（指病房里每一处旁边的那一处）
B. n. 感染；发炎（指那处伤口本身，与棉签相对）
C. 固定搭配：treat the infection 医治这处感染
D. n. 感染；发炎（指留给孩子们化验的那一支那一处）
E. n. 防治之事（抽象总称，指一处病房的感染之事）
F. n. 感染；发炎（指病历里写到、被记下的的那一处）
G. n. 风险、隐患（指一件事里人人都防却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 隐患（抽象总称，指人人都防却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: treated the infection that no sister in the ward would have recorded
The infection, meaning the wound itself and not the swab
the infection at the far tray
the infection was the whole of the matter
the infection had become a line in a chart
The infection of the whole thing
A infection, my mother said in 1985

answers.why: treat the infection 意为“医治这处感染”，1976 年那位内科医生把病房里没有一位护士长肯记录的一处感染做了一遍。
infection 意为“感染；发炎”，指那处伤口本身而不是棉签，它经过了三个星期一而在簿子上没有被记录。
infection 意为“感染；发炎”，指病房里每一处旁边的那一处，每一处旁边都有同一支小小的棉签。
infection 意为“感染；发炎”，指最远那个托盘留给孩子们化验的那一支那一处，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
infection 意为“风险、隐患”，指一件事里人人都防却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份风险就是那件事的全部。
infection 意为“隐患”，指人人都防却无人提起的那样东西而不是那处伤口，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
infection 意为“感染；发炎”，指病历里写到、被记下的的那一处，到 1981 年这一处成了病历里的一行。
infection 意为“防治之事”，内科医生三月写道，整件事的感染之事是一处病房和三个星期一的记录。
infection 意为“感染；发炎”，我记得的是病历里记录过的那一处，1983 年控制了，至今仍被说成病房里最安静的一处。
infection 为抽象总称，母亲 1985 年说，感染是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的伤口。
